question: Who among the following authors wrote ‘Kamayani’, ‘Dhruvswamini’, ‘Kankal’, ‘Titli’, ‘Skandagupta’, ‘Lahar’ and ‘Mamta’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jaishankar Prasad**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Jaishankar Prasad was a renowned Hindi poet, playwright, and novelist, primarily associated with the Chhayavad (Neo-romanticism) literary movement in Hindi literature.
 
• He authored celebrated works such as **'Kamayani'**, which is considered one of the greatest epic poems in Hindi literature.
 
• His notable dramas include **'Dhruvswamini'** and **'Skandagupta'**, which reflect themes of Indian history and valor.
 
• Other famous literary works by him include novels like **'Kankal'** and **'Titli'**, and collections of stories and poetry like **'Lahar'** and **'Mamta'**.
 
• Jaishankar Prasad's literary contributions played a pivotal role in shaping modern Hindi literature and establishing it as a prominent literary language in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chhayavad Movement:**

 
 
• Chhayavad was a Hindi literary movement that emerged in the early 20th century, characterized by romanticism, mysticism, and a focus on emotions and individualism.
 
• Key figures of this movement included Jaishankar Prasad, Suryakant Tripathi Nirala, Mahadevi Verma, and Sumitranandan Pant.
 
 
 
• **'Kamayani':**
 
 
• 'Kamayani' is a philosophical and allegorical epic that explores human emotions like faith, love, and intellect through mythological characters.
 
• The poem is divided into cantos, each representing a different emotion or concept, such as Shraddha (Faith) and Manas (Mind).
 
 
 
• **'Dhruvswamini':**
 
 
• It is a historical drama that portrays the story of a queen who rebels against societal norms for her dignity and love.
 
• The play reflects Prasad's progressive views on women's empowerment and self-determination.
 
 
 
• **Jaishankar Prasad's Legacy:**
 
 
• He was awarded the title of "Prasad" for his literary excellence and remains a foundational figure in Hindi literature.
 
• His works continue to influence contemporary writers and are part of academic curricula in India.
